lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na4Mg2Si2O8 (reduced formula Na2MgSiO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers coordinated by four O neighbors, Na centers by six O neighbors, and Si centers tetrahedrally coordinated by four O neighbors; the O centers have three geometric neighbors (one Mg, two Na, or one Si). Corner-sharing is observed between Si tetrahedra, between Mg and Si polyhedra, and between Na and Si polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
